text: {"frames":["A hiss of hot iron and the sharp smell of wet ash rose from the forge at the foot of the Tower. The smith, Sietske Hamervlam, tapped her anvil with a cold hammer and kept glancing at the canal. The coal cart was late, and the carter shouted up the stairwell that only {x} of the coal ordered for the forge had come. Sietske wiped her soot-black hands on her apron and stared at the empty sacks. What percentage of the order has arrived?","A white feather floated down the stairwell before anyone heard the flutter of wings. Joost Mallemolen, the cheese maker on the fourth floor, found a letter tied to the leg of a grey pigeon. The pigeon had flown to the wrong door, and the letter was meant for the cellar of the tower across the canal. It said that {x} of the wheels of cheese in the Tower's cellar were ready for the market. What percentage of the cheeses is that?","'Your scales are crooked, Gerrit!' yelled Pieter Klompvent across the market square. Gerrit Zoutlaan slapped his hand on his barrel of salted herring and shouted back that he had sold most of his stock before noon. The crowd of gulls screamed and dove for the scraps on the cobbles. By Gerrit's own count, {x} of his herring had already gone into customers' baskets. What percentage of his herring has been sold?","Captain Anneke Roeiboot dipped her oar into the black water of the underground lake and squinted into the dim light of her lantern. Somewhere ahead, the stone pier should have been waiting, but only dripping walls rose on either side. She checked her rope, which she had knotted at equal lengths from the boat's bow. The rope showed that she had already rowed {x} of the way to the pier. What percentage of the journey is still ahead of her?","'Please, can you help me before the market bell rings?' asked Dirkje Vlotbak, tugging at the sleeve of the fishmonger's boy. Her herring stall stood beside the canal, and a loud quarrel had broken out over the last barrel. The fishmonger said that {x} of the fish from the morning catch was already gone. Dirkje's mother wanted to know how much of the catch was left for her own stall. What percentage of the morning catch has been sold?"]}
